changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE platform_billing_plan ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS retailer_type_code character varying(64); COMMENT ON COLUMN platform_billing_plan.retailer_type_code IS 'Shop pack this catalog price is limited to, such as GAS_STATION or LIQUOR_STORE. Empty means the plan applies to every retail pack. Event-site plans leave this empty.';
